BRIJESH CHANDRA TRIPATHI S/O LATE SHRI  RAJARAM, AGED ABOUT 52 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 BUSINESS R/O- VILLAGE THINGPUR HARI NAGAR  SIKANDARPUR KANNAUJ (UTTAR PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PRASHANT SHARMA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION- CITY KOTWALI DISTRICT BHIND (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI A.P.S. TOMAR- PANEL LAWYER FOR STATE)
 (BY SHRI DEVESH SHARMA - ADVOCATE FOR THE COMPLAINANT)
 This application coming on for hearing this day, the cou  following:
 ORDER

This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed for grant of bail to the applicant in connection with Crime No.557/2022, for the offences punishable under Section 420, 34, 406, 409 of the IPC, registered at Police Station- City Kotwali, District Bhind.

sentences.text: T h e applicant herein is in judicial custody since 17.01.2023 in the aforementioned case.
He has been arrested on account of not retuning an alleged amount of Rs.90 lacs taken from the complainant in cash pursuant to the partnership deed for running mine situated at Uttar Pradesh.

The objection raised by the learned counsel for the complainant and the State is that Rs.90 lac was paid in cash to the applicant and that he was not returning the money when demanded as the Brijesh Chandra Tripathi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66277244/
1 partnership firm was not working as desired.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the complainants have no proof to show that Rs.90 lac was ever paid to him in cash.

sentences.text: Undisputedly, there is no receipt executed by the applicant in favour of the complainants of having received Rs.90 lac in cash from them.

However, by way of bank transfer, there is evidence that Rs.14 lac was transferred by the complainants into the account of the applicant, out of which there is evidence to show that Rs.10 lac was returned by the applicant to the complainant's account.

As regard the balance amount of Rs.4 lac, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has got four demand drafts were prepared in the name of each of the partners who are also complainants herein amounting to Rs.1 lac each.
He says that he has brought the said demand drafts with them and the same have been handed over to the learned counsel for the complainants who acknowledged receipt for the same.

Additionally, learned counsel for the complainants also submits that on 27.01.2021 complainant executed a declaration in favour of the applicant to the effect that he has received Rs.90 lac in cash from the complainants in the year 1999.
This deed of declaration is executed on 27.01.2021.
When shown learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the deed of declaration is prima facie fabricated.

He further submits that it is probable that the applicant herein may have given a blank stamp paper valued at Rs.10/- to the complainants, which was misused by them for typing the fabricated deed of declaration over his signature.
In order to buttress his arguments, he submits that signature purporting to be that of the applicant is below typed out portion reflecting "declarant" while it should have been above that.
He submits that as the document was prepared subsequently the alignment was spoiled which clearly reflects that the applicant did not sign the deed of declaration after it was prepared.
He further submits that there are no witnesses to the execution of this deed of declaration, which also makes it suspicious.
Under the circumstances, in view of what has been argued and considered by this Court hereinabove, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant herein shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court.

The copy of this order is directed to be sent to the Income Tax Department to assess how, if true, the complainants have paid Rs.90 lac in cash to the applicant and whether the same was disclosed as income to the Tax Authorities.
With the above, the application is disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
